review.notes: All 33 physical pages compared token-by-token against the OCR markdown (case/punctuation-normalized, hyphenation-tolerant), full code-fence audit (balanced), and heading audit against the printed outline (all 47 headings legitimate). Pages 1, 10 and 13 were rendered (120 dpi page, 300 dpi bottom crops) to verify the three footnote restorations. The document's only printed footnotes (1 on page 1, 2 on page 10, 3 on page 13) had their bodies dropped by OCR while the superscript markers survived inline; each body was transcribed from the rendered page and appended after the paragraph carrying its marker, following the established footnote-restoration pattern in this repository. Verified non-defects: the Figure 4 caption's 'and also also prior models like GPT-4o' duplicates 'also' in the PDF's own print (page 14) and was kept; 'trou-bleshooting', 'ques-tions', 'multi-ple' style token diffs are print hyphenation inside table cells and embedded figure axis labels (Figures 3-5); the Appendix (7.1) duplicates Apollo evaluation prose that also prints in the source.
